name: 서지안

appearance_en.face_shape: sharp elongated oval face, high defined cheekbones, clean narrow jaw — the face a room notices before it decides to. Structured coldly, the kind that reads as untouchable until the exact moment she chooses otherwise
appearance_en.skin: pale cool Korean skin, flawless maintained surface — the skin of someone for whom appearance is professional infrastructure, not vanity
appearance_en.eyes: deep double-eyelid dark eyes, long upturned outer corners, heavy upper lids giving the gaze weight — the eyes that assess without revealing assessment. Rendered in ink as still water over considerable depth
appearance_en.nose: straight high-bridge nose, defined and slightly strong — gives the face structure that reads as authority in every panel
appearance_en.mouth: well-shaped full lips, cooler natural tone, slightly parted at rest — the mouth that produces '선이 움직인 거죠' in a register that sounds like observation and lands like verdict
appearance_en.eyebrows: cleanly shaped dark brows with precise arch — the brow that lowers very slightly when she has identified something useful. Readable in silhouette
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: the symmetry is the mark. No moles, no asymmetry — the kind of face that unsettles by being too composed
appearance_en.hair: dark straight hair, collarbone to shoulder, in perfect condition — down or in a sleek low knot. Never between

body.proportions: slim elongated frame, long neck, precise posture — physical presentation as professional instrument
body.posture: perfectly upright and controlled — the posture that signals professional context even in personal space
body.body_prompt: 167cm slim elongated Korean woman, long neck, impeccably upright controlled posture

default.description: precisely fitted blazer in charcoal or navy, silk blouse, tailored trousers, mid-heel pumps, single gold earring — dressed to be taken seriously, not to be liked
default.wardrobe_prompt: precisely fitted charcoal or navy blazer, silk blouse, tailored straight trousers, single understated gold earring

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: cool and assessing — always reading the room, never showing the reading. When she smiles it is a decision, compositionally framed as such
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 33-year-old Korean woman, sharp elongated oval face with high cheekbones and narrow jaw, deep double-eyelid dark eyes with long upturned outer corners and heavy lids, precisely arched dark brows, straight high-bridge nose, full cool-toned lips slightly parted, dark straight immaculate collarbone-length hair or sleek low knot, 167cm slim elongated upright frame, pale cool maintained Korean skin

style_prompt: Studio Ghibli heartwarming hand-painted watercolor art style with cool precision, expressive face of calculated beauty and deliberate composure, sleek professional interior with cool ambient painterly light, cinematic dramatic backlighting with sharp silver rim lights, iridescent prism refractions from glass and polished surfaces, magical realism of predatory stillness, cool diffused interior light, Korean drama cinematic composition, intelligence as the dominant aesthetic force in every brushstroke
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, manga ink lines, screen tone, looking at camera, eye contact, facing camera, warm, casual, round face, approachable, cheerful, glamorous overstatement
